data.name: Draconic
data.desc: Typical speakers include dragons and dragonborn.

actions.name: Acid Breath
actions.desc: The dragon exhales sizzling acid in a 60-foot-long  5-foot-wide line. Each creature in that area makes a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw  taking 63 (14d8) acid damage on a failed save or half damage on a success. A creature that fails the save is blinded until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Acid Spit
actions.desc: The dragon targets a creature within 60 feet  forcing it to make a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw. The creature takes 22 (4d10) acid damage on a failure or half damage on a success. A creature that fails the save also takes 5 (1d10) ongoing acid damage. A creature can use an action to end the ongoing damage.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (3d10 + 6) piercing damage plus 4 (1d8) acid damage. Instead of dealing piercing damage  the dragon can grapple the target (escape DC 20)  and a Large or smaller creature grappled in this way is restrained. While grappling a creature  the dragon can't bite or use Acid Spit against another target.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (3d8 + 6) slashing damage.

actions.name: Darkness
actions.desc: The dragon creates a 20-foot-radius sphere of magical darkness originating from a point it can see within 120 feet. Darkvision can't penetrate this darkness. The darkness lasts for 1 minute or until the dragon uses this action again.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The dragon attacks once with its bite and twice with its claws. In place of its bite attack  it can use Acid Spit.

actions.name: Roar
actions.desc: Each creature of the dragons choice within 120 feet that can hear it makes a DC 17 Charisma saving throw. On a failure, it is frightened for 1 minute. A creature repeats the saving throw at the end of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. When it succeeds on a saving throw or the effect ends for it, it is immune to Roar for 24 hours.

actions.name: Tail
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage  and the dragon pushes the target 10 feet away.

actions.name: Tail Attack
actions.desc: When a creature the dragon can see within 10 feet hits the dragon with a melee attack, the dragon makes a tail attack against it.

actions.name: The dragon can take 3 legendary actions
actions.desc: Only one legendary action can be used at a time and only at the end of another creatures turn. It regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.

actions.name: Wing Attack
actions.desc: The dragon beats its wings. Each creature within 15 feet makes a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, it is pushed 10 feet away and knocked prone. The dragon can then fly up to half its fly speed.

traits.name: Ambusher
traits.desc: When submerged in water, the dragon has advantage on Stealth checks. If the dragon hits a creature that can't see it with its bite, it can deal piercing damage and grapple the target simultaneously.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.desc: The dragon can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc:
The dragons spellcasting ability is Charisma (save DC 17). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components.
- **3/Day Each:**Fog Cloud, Pass Without Trace, Legend Lore, Speak with Dead

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: When the dragon fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. When it does, it sheds some of its scales, which turn to mud. If it has no more uses of this ability, its Armor Class is reduced to 17 until it finishes a long rest.

traits.name: Ruthless (1/Round)
traits.desc: After scoring a critical hit on its turn, the dragon can immediately make one claw attack.
